parole.significato: The Soviet machinery of state bureaucratic administration, or a similar communistic structure.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian аппара́т (apparát, “apparatus, apparat”). Doublet of apparatus.

parole.significato: In the Russian Empire, a person who farmed local rents or revenues.
parole.testo: From Russian аренда́тор (arendátor), from Latin arendator, arrendator, from arendare, arrendare (“to pay rent”), from arenda (“yearly rent”), from ad + renda (whence French rente, English rent). Compare arrentation and rent.

parole.significato: One of a set of wooden Russian dolls of different sizes, designed such that each fits inside the next.
parole.testo: From Russian матрёшка (matrjóška), from personal name Матрёна (Matrjóna), formerly Матрона (Matrona), ultimately from Latin mātrōna (“matron”).
